diving.name: Diving & Snorkeling
diving.description: Explore the world-famous coral reefs of the Red Sea — beginner snorkeling trips, certified dive courses and full-day safaris to Ras Mohammed and Tiran Island.

safari.name: Desert Safari & Quad Biking
safari.description: Ride into the Sinai desert by jeep or quad bike, visit a Bedouin camp, watch the sunset over the dunes and enjoy dinner under the stars.

boat.name: Boat Trips & Island Tours
boat.description: Sail across the turquoise waters of the Red Sea on a glass-bottom boat, a traditional sailing yacht or a sunset dinner cruise.

daytrips.name: Day Trips & Excursions
daytrips.description: Full-day journeys to Egypt's greatest landmarks — the Pyramids of Giza, the Egyptian Museum in Cairo, and the ancient city of Petra in Jordan.

waterparks.name: Water Parks & Attractions
waterparks.description: Family-friendly fun at Sharm El Sheikh's best water parks, marine shows and aquariums — perfect for a relaxed day with the kids.

transfers.name: Transfers & Private Transport
transfers.description: Comfortable, air-conditioned private transfers between the airport, your hotel and anywhere in Sharm El Sheikh, with English-speaking drivers.

tiran-snorkeling.title: Tiran Island Snorkeling Trip
tiran-snorkeling.shortDescription: A full day of snorkeling over pristine coral reefs around Tiran Island, with lunch and drinks on board.
tiran-snorkeling.longDescription: Sail by comfortable boat to the protected reefs surrounding Tiran Island, one of the richest snorkeling spots in the Red Sea. Glide over vibrant coral gardens and spot colorful reef fish, turtles and occasionally dolphins. Our experienced guides assist beginners and free divers alike, and all equipment is included. Relax on deck between snorkeling stops with a freshly prepared lunch buffet and unlimited soft drinks before returning to your hotel in the late afternoon.

ras-mohammed-diving.title: Ras Mohammed Diving Safari
ras-mohammed-diving.shortDescription: Two-tank scuba diving trip to the legendary Ras Mohammed National Park for certified divers.
ras-mohammed-diving.longDescription: Discover why Ras Mohammed is considered one of the top diving destinations on earth. This two-tank boat safari takes certified divers to dramatic reef walls, swim-throughs and an abundance of marine life, including reef sharks, napoleon wrasse and sea turtles. PADI-certified instructors and dive guides accompany every group, and all tanks, weights and park fees are included. Suitable for divers from Open Water level upward; equipment rental and Discover Scuba sessions are available on request.

desert-safari-dinner.title: Bedouin Desert Safari with Dinner & Stargazing
desert-safari-dinner.shortDescription: Jeep safari into the Sinai desert with camel riding, a Bedouin dinner and traditional show.
desert-safari-dinner.longDescription: Leave the city behind on an exciting 4x4 jeep ride deep into the Sinai desert. Stop for spectacular sunset views over the mountains, take a short camel ride and visit a genuine Bedouin camp for a tea ceremony. As night falls, enjoy a generous barbecue dinner under a sky full of stars, with live music and a tanoura show. An unforgettable evening that combines adventure, culture and Sinai's legendary hospitality.

quad-bike-sunset.title: Sunset Quad Bike Adventure
quad-bike-sunset.shortDescription: Self-drive quad bike tour through the desert dunes and a Bedouin village at sunset.
quad-bike-sunset.longDescription: Take control of your own quad bike and race across the golden dunes of the Sinai desert, guided by experienced instructors who lead a safe and thrilling route. Stop at a Bedouin village to meet local families, sip traditional tea and watch the sun set behind the mountains. A safety briefing and helmets are provided, and single or double quads are available for couples and families.

glass-boat.title: Glass Bottom Boat & Coral Reef Tour
glass-boat.shortDescription: A relaxed cruise to view coral reefs and tropical fish through the boat's glass floor — no swimming required.
glass-boat.longDescription: Perfect for non-swimmers, families with small children, and anyone who wants to see the Red Sea's underwater world while staying dry. Our glass-bottom boat glides slowly over shallow reefs, giving you a clear view of corals, fish and other marine life through large glass panels. The trip also includes a stop at a quiet bay for those who would like to swim or snorkel, plus refreshments on board.

sailing-sunset.title: Sunset Sailing Cruise with BBQ Dinner
sailing-sunset.shortDescription: Romantic sunset cruise along the Sharm El Sheikh coastline with a barbecue dinner and live music.
sailing-sunset.longDescription: Set sail on a traditional wooden boat as the sun sets over the Red Sea, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink. Enjoy a freshly grilled barbecue dinner on deck, accompanied by live music, while sailing past Naama Bay and the dramatic coastline. A great choice for couples, honeymooners and anyone looking for a memorable evening on the water.

cairo-pyramids.title: Cairo, Pyramids & Egyptian Museum Day Trip
cairo-pyramids.shortDescription: Full-day flight excursion to Cairo to see the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx and the Egyptian Museum.
cairo-pyramids.longDescription: Fly from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo for an unforgettable day exploring Egypt's ancient wonders. Stand face to face with the Great Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx, learn about Pharaonic history from your expert Egyptologist guide, and admire thousands of artifacts — including treasures from Tutankhamun's tomb — at the Egyptian Museum. Lunch at a local restaurant with Nile views is included before your evening flight back.

petra-jordan.title: Petra, Jordan Full-Day Excursion
petra-jordan.shortDescription: Cross into Jordan for a guided full-day tour of the legendary rose-red city of Petra.
petra-jordan.longDescription: Travel by speedboat or flight to Jordan and journey through the narrow Siq canyon to discover Petra, one of the New Seven Wonders of the World. Marvel at the Treasury carved directly into pink sandstone cliffs, explore tombs and temples over 2,000 years old, and learn the fascinating history of the Nabataean civilization from your licensed guide. Lunch and all border-crossing arrangements are taken care of for a smooth, hassle-free day.

aqua-park.title: Aqua Park Day Pass & Water Slides
aqua-park.shortDescription: A full day of fun at one of Sharm El Sheikh's top water parks, with slides and pools for all ages.
aqua-park.longDescription: Spend a fun-filled day at one of Sharm El Sheikh's most popular water parks, featuring thrilling slides, a lazy river and dedicated pools for younger children. Sun loungers and umbrellas are available throughout the park, and a selection of cafés and restaurants means you won't have to leave for lunch. A perfect choice for families looking for a relaxed day away from the beach.

dolphin-show.title: Dolphin Show & Marine Park Visit
dolphin-show.shortDescription: Watch a live dolphin show and meet the friendly residents of Sharm El Sheikh's marine park.
dolphin-show.longDescription: Enjoy an entertaining show featuring trained dolphins performing acrobatic jumps and playful tricks, followed by the option to get up close with these intelligent animals during an optional swim or photo session. The marine park also features seals and other marine life exhibits, making it a great half-day outing for the whole family.

airport-transfer.title: Private Airport Transfer (Sharm El Sheikh)
airport-transfer.shortDescription: Private, air-conditioned vehicle between Sharm El Sheikh International Airport and your hotel.
airport-transfer.longDescription: Skip the queues and shared shuttles with a private transfer that takes you directly from Sharm El Sheikh Airport to your hotel, or back to the airport at the end of your trip. Your driver will track your flight and wait for you at arrivals with a name board, ready to help with luggage. Vehicles are modern, air-conditioned and available for groups of any size.

private-driver.title: Private Car with Driver - Full Day
private-driver.shortDescription: Hire a private car and English-speaking driver for a full day of sightseeing or shopping at your own pace.
private-driver.longDescription: Enjoy total flexibility with your own private car and driver for the day. Whether you'd like to visit several attractions, go shopping in Naama Bay's Old Market, or design a custom itinerary, your driver is at your service from morning until evening. A great option for families and small groups who prefer privacy and a personalized schedule over a fixed group tour.

about.title: About Sharm Horizon Tours
about.subtitle: Your trusted local travel agency in Sharm El Sheikh since 2010
about.intro: Sharm Horizon Tours is a Sharm El Sheikh-based travel agency specializing in diving, desert safaris, boat trips and excursions across Egypt and Jordan. Founded by a team of local guides and divers, we have welcomed travelers from over 40 countries and pride ourselves on safety, fair prices and unforgettable experiences.
about.missionText: To share the natural beauty and culture of South Sinai with the world, through safe, high-quality and authentic excursions for every type of traveler.
about.teamText: Our guides and customer service team speak English, Arabic, Russian, Ukrainian and Italian, so you can plan and enjoy your trip in your own language.
about.licensesText: Registered with the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism, with PADI-certified dive instructors and fully insured vehicles and boats.
